title: deal
summary: Distribute input values to requested outputs.

gpu_support.notes: `deal` performs no numeric computation. RunMat can pass resident values through without gather behind an explicit compatibility gate.

fusion.notes: `deal` is output-list construction and is not fused.

description: `[B1,...,Bn] = deal(A1,...,An)` copies matching inputs positionally. `[B1,...,Bn] = deal(A)` copies one input to every requested output.
behaviors: With multiple inputs, the number of requested outputs must equal the number of inputs.
With one input, any requested output count receives the same value.
Values pass through structurally without numeric conversion, preserving integer class, shape, exact values, and handle identity.
Resident pass-through is a RunMat-only extension because the current public page documents GPU code generation but not interactive GPU Arrays. The gate runs without gather or provider access.
RunMat does not retain the former one-output cell-packing behavior; use a cell-array literal when a packed cell row is intended.

examples.output: a is int64(7) and b is uint64(9).
All three outputs preserve the exact uint64 value.

faqs.question: Does `deal` convert integer inputs to double?
faqs.answer: No. It copies values without arithmetic or class conversion.

example.output: Outputs preserve their corresponding input values.

points: Multiple inputs require the same number of outputs.
One input is replicated to every requested output.

validation.summary: Focused tests cover matching distribution, single-input replication, count errors, all eight exact integer storage classes, zero-output behavior, and pre-access resident gating.

gpu_residency: When its RunMat-only extension is enabled, `deal` preserves a resident handle and its owner without gather, upload, allocation, or provider dispatch.
